bm_gram_rb4.notes: Leaf Gram with 64x64 tile pairs and a 4x4 register micro-tile per thread (16 FMAs per 8 shared loads vs 1 per 2; 4x fewer global re-reads of each staged row). Each cell keeps its ascending-row chain from +0.0, so leaf partial words and the fold are unchanged. Workloads: ridge/OLS-Gram istella, PCA, LDA (d >= 64).
